rules.accepted_credit_types: Points in OAR 339-020-0020 categories, must relate to OT services with an 'Application to OT Services' CE log. Unless stated otherwise 1 point = 1 contact hour. 16–30 points from categories 1–10 (college courses 4 points per credit hour; seminars/workshops 1 per hour; online courses as certified; AOTA-approved provider, OTAO, AOTA, NBCOT activities 1 per hour; publications 5–14; presentations 2 per hour; alternative media 3 per hour, etc.); max 14 points from categories 11–18.
rules.alternatives: Current NBCOT certification satisfies the 30 points, but not the cultural competency or pain management requirements.
rules.audit_note: Licensees upload completion certificates into the License Portal at renewal (non-NBCOT-certified licensees upload 30 points and explain relevance). Random audits under OAR 339-020-0080; keep records at least 4 years.

topics.who: All licensees, every renewal; course of the licensee's choice (OHA list suggested); may also count toward the 30 points
Oregon Pain Management Commission module (OHA), every license cycle; proof required since 2024 renewals

rules.notes: Points must be earned in the 2 years before renewal. Renewed licenses run through May 31, 2028 (2026 renewal season closed). Waivers for disability, illness or undue hardship (OAR 339-020-0090).
rules.rule_quote: (1) All current licensees shall obtain a minimum of 30 points of CE from Board approved categories during the two years immediately preceding the date of the license renewal;
